5 Oct 2026 — TWO PIDS RE-DECLARED, and the id is deliberately NOT changed. `joanna-defranceschi-1848` and its duplicate were minted from the family tree's «Joanna Defranceschi, born 9 June 1848». The Gologorica baptism register (DAPA ZM34K-214, M01069123, folio 109) names that child ROSA, born 7 June 1848, and a later hand adds her death: 10 December 1899. One child, not two — a mother cannot bear children two days apart. The rows now carry her real name and her death year; the pids still read «joanna», because a moved id is a dead URL and these addresses were published. This is a RENAME, not a reuse: same person, better name. The gate was right to stop and this note is the re-declaration it asked for. See /corrections/.

6 Oct 2026 — `maximilianus-josephus-de-franceschi-1813` RE-DECLARED with a death year, 1817. The roster row was tree-only and carried d=null with the note «no register has been read for this person here», while gologorica.json had already recorded @I17@ with death 19 DEC 1817 earlier the same day. That is a propagation gap, not a new finding: the death register entry (DAPA ZM34K-214, M01069257, page 58) reads «Die 19: Xbris 1817 hora 10ma noctu · 17 · Maximilianus Joseph Defranceschi, D.ni Josephi filius · 4 anni, mens. fere 3 · Vermes et Tussis cum febri maligna», buried the 20th «sub solis occasum ob signa putrefactionis». Birth NOT declared: four years three months in December 1817 implies about September 1813, and an implied year is not a declared one. The pid keeps 1813. He is the ELDER Maximilianus; the 1828 son of the same house who carried the name again is a separate declared pid.

6 Oct 2026 — `josephus-defranceschi-1763` RE-DECLARED: birth 1763 -> 1765. The pid slug keeps 1763 because a moved id is a dead URL. This is a PROPAGATION FIX, not a new finding: gologorica.json already carried «born 4 March 1765» for @I34@, documented, and noted it as a correction of the earlier «about 1763» — but the roster row still had 1763 and an empty note. Found by walking page 75 of the death register (DAPA ZM34K-214, M01069266), which gives «Xbris 12° · Josephus Defranceschi · 74 · 9 · 7 · febris nervosa». The register's age implies a birth of 5 March 1764 and so does NOT close against the written 4 March 1765; the written birth is kept and the inconsistency is recorded on the row rather than smoothed away. Second stale roster row caught this afternoon by the same method; see also `maximilianus-josephus-de-franceschi-1813`.

6 Oct 2026 — `clementina-maria-defranceschi-1822` RE-DECLARED: death 1840 -> 1870. Not a new person and not a judgement call: this row had carried an explicit note since 20 September saying the tree (1870) and this archive (1840) disagreed by thirty years and that «this needs the burial register, not a judgement». The burial register was walked today and gives «1870 Martii 10ma · 7 · Clementina Defranceschi, possidens, munita SS Sacram. et sepulta 11. Martii · 47 · Phthisis» (DAPA ZM34K-214, M01069286, page 114). Aged 47 on 10 March 1870 closes exactly on the declared birth of 3 October 1822; at 10 March 1840 she would have been 17. The day and month were right in both; only the decade was wrong. The pid keeps 1822 because it encodes the BIRTH year, which is unchanged. See /corrections/.
